title: The most dangerous kind of good person…
paragraphs:
The most dangerous kind of good person…
Is the one who no longer thinks they need saving.

Good behavior can hide a proud heart.
Clean habits can cover quiet self-trust.
Religion can replace relationship.

When “I’m not that bad” becomes your defense,
you stop reaching for mercy.

Jesus didn’t warn the obvious sinners.
He warned the self-assured.
“I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.” – Luke 5:32

The safest place to be isn’t “good enough.”
It’s aware of your need.

Before correcting someone else today…
Ask: Where am I depending on myself instead of God?
Type “MERCY” if you never want to outgrow your need for God.
